scenes.title: Dreamworld and Dark Memories
scenes.rationale: Kenzo's private spirit journey flows into one continuous morning conversation on the mesa in which the party compares supernatural experiences and adds Ander's Raven's Hold account to its possible leads.

scenes.title: Spearpoints and a Throwing Net
scenes.rationale: The afternoon visit to Jasu introduces a new location and immediate goal: examining Arcus's spearpoints and negotiating Seeker's commission.

scenes.title: The Festival of Rebirth
scenes.rationale: The gifts, staff-dancing tournament, rumor exchange, and axebeak race form the festival interlude while the party waits for the scouts, ending when Alesh and Havdar return with urgent news.

scenes.title: The Fate of Karawa
scenes.rationale: The scouts' reports, the party's questions, Kenzo's proposal, and the final assignments are one uninterrupted council meeting with the single goal of deciding how Karawa should respond.
